symbols.read: The bullish flip holds — price at 743.69 is still above the 737.02 support that confirmed the 4H flip, so the prior BUY lean is intact and the invalidated SELL at 722.40 stays dead. What changed is momentum: the 1H printed its first down bar (742.79→741.69, -0.15%), which downgrades the combined signal from BUY to HOLD even as the 4H stays bullish. A new bull FVG at 739.63–739.88 now sits just below price, giving a shallow pullback zone that overlaps the 737.02 support — a dip into that band is a buy, not a breakdown. Bias remains bullish toward the 758.44 upper pivot; invalidation is a sustained move below 737.02, which would reopen 722.40 and then 686.36.

Price pushed higher to 83,150.01, so the bearish SELL setup stays fully invalidated well above the 82,413.00 stop, but the combined 4H+1H call has cooled from BUY to HOLD even as the 4H stays bullish and the 1H trend remains up. The key change is that the former bear FVG at 82,664.01–82,692.84 has flipped to a bull FVG now spanning 82,664.01–82,805.35, joining the bull zones at 81,777.63–82,100.00 and 82,171.80–82,211.21 as stacked pullback demand beneath price. Bias stays bullish but with less momentum conviction: 84,352.00 is the upside pivot that confirms continuation, while 81,033.66 is the lower pivot whose break revives the bearish case. Invalidation of the bullish lean is a close back below the 81,777.63 FVG base.

Price has pushed through the 2,441.67–2,444.52 bearish FVG that capped the prior read and now sits at 2,455.39, so the constructive bias is confirmed and the overhead cap is cleared; the 4H direction has also flipped from bearish to bullish, aligning with the 1H uptrend and the bullish regime, though the combined signal stays HOLD. The bullish FVG shelf at 2,403.94–2,409.12 remains the demand base and the 2,403.69 lower pivot the line in the sand. Bias is constructive toward the 2,579.88 upper pivot; invalidation is a close back below 2,403.69, which reopens the 2,354.54–2,370.66 shelf and the 2,227.50 target. Note the SELL signal is flagged invalidated and the last 1H bar is soft (-0.27%), so momentum into the pivot still needs to prove itself.

Price has pushed further into the pivot zone (106.61 to 106.82) but still cannot clear the 107.16 lower pivot, so the long trigger toward 113.40 remains unfired and the bias stays neutral-to-bullish. The 1H trend is still up and FVGs remain empty, but the latest 1H bar (106.86→106.54, -0.30%) is a second consecutive weak, red close, confirming fading momentum rather than a breakout. The SELL setup stays invalidated (entry 107.16, stop 107.19), keeping the 100.92 downside target off the table. Nothing has structurally changed versus the prior read — same range, same trigger, same invalidation: a close below the 104.46 zone would revive the bear case, while a clean break of 107.16 opens 113.40.

Price has edged up to 57.78 but remains pinned below the 58.41 pivot, so the structure is essentially unchanged from the prior read: 4H bearish, 1H up, combined HOLD, bias neutral. The only open FVG is still the 57.198–57.367 bull shelf, which continues to underpin the range; the 58.41 short entry has expired untriggered once more, so no live position exists. Bias stays neutral until either a sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward 61.45, or a clean break below 57.00 through the remaining FVG re-asserts the bearish case toward 55.37.

The bearish bias remains intact and is now confirmed by the 1H trend turning down, with price at 4,114.10 holding below the flipped 4,141.44 resistance — the prior read's failed-reclaim thesis played out as expected. The SELL setup is flagged INVALIDATED, but that reflects the original entry trigger rather than a trend reversal, since 4H direction and the combined read both stay bearish. Key levels are unchanged: 4,141.44 is the short trigger on any retest, 4,065.48 the downside target, and a sustained reclaim above 4,148.48 the invalidation. No open FVGs and a neutral regime keep the path to target clean, so the bias stays bearish — only a close above 4,148.48 would revise it.

Bias stays neutral-to-bullish and has firmed again: price ticked from 1.33 to 1.34 and the 4H direction has flipped from bearish to bullish, so the prior read's upside lean is confirmed and its invalidation condition (a break back below 1.31) remains unmet. The combined 4H+1H signal holds at HOLD with the SELL setup still invalidated, and the BULLISH regime label persists as the supporting input. Key levels are unchanged: 1.33 is now support, with a fresh bull FVG at 1.3304–1.3307 just beneath it, a sustained push above opens the 1.43 upper pivot, and a drop back under 1.31 revives the 1.20 target. Invalidation: a sustained break back below 1.31.
